result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The window links the desert towers to Uzziah’s livestock, not to his love of farming. His being “a lover of the soil” instead explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers. Also, “watch towers” is less precise than the text’s “towers” and could refer either to the fortified Jerusalem towers or the desert towers. The question should specify the desert towers; the supported answer is that he had much livestock in the foothills and plain.
